text.text: The Cisco UCS 6248UP 48-Port Fabric Interconnect is a core part of the Cisco Unified Computing System. Typically deployed in redundant pairs, the Cisco UCS 6248UP Fabric Interconnects provide uniform access to both networks and storage. The 6248UP provides in a 1RU form factor, up to 960 Gbps of bandwidth, 48 Unified Ports that can be configured as 1/10 Gigabit Ethernet, Fibre Channel over Ethernet and 8/4/2/1 Fibre Channel ports.

text.text: The Cisco UCS 6248UP 48-Port Fabric Interconnect is a core part of the Cisco Unified Computing System. Typically deployed in redundant pairs, the Cisco UCS 6248UP Fabric Interconnects provide uniform access to both networks and storage. The Cisco UCS 6248UP comes with enhanced features and benefits such as 960 Gpbs bandwidth, higher port density (48 Unified ports in a 1RU form factor), high-performance, low-latency Unified Ports that can be configured as lossless 1/10 Gigabit Ethernet, Fibre Channel over Ethernet (FCoE), and 8/4/2/1 Fibre Channel port types.
